Liji 26 · Kongzi Xian Ju 孔子閒居 · Confucius At Home At Leisure · Kongzi Xian Ju 9

items.text: Remember and honor the good fame of your forefathers.
items.quote: it was necessary that they should be preceded by the fame of their forefathers

items.text: Display civil virtues so that they permeate the whole household.
items.quote: He displayed his civil virtues, And they permeated all parts of the kingdom
